restore_gms_doze: dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +com.google.android.gms && dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +com.android.vending
restore_game_mode: settings delete global game_mode_on && settings delete global game_driver_all_apps
restore_game_driver: settings delete global game_driver_all_apps && settings delete global game_driver_opt_in_all_apps
restore_power_mode: cmd power set-fixed-performance-mode-enabled false && cmd power set-adaptive-power-saver-enabled true
restore_fps_unlocker: settings delete system peak_refresh_rate && settings delete system min_refresh_rate && settings delete secure user_refresh_rate
restore_background_limiter: settings delete global background_process_limit && settings delete global activity_manager_constants
restore_animation_speed: settings put global window_animation_scale 1.0 && settings put global transition_animation_scale 1.0 && settings put global animator_duration_scale 1.0
restore_gpu_rendering: setprop debug.hwui.force_hw_ui false && settings delete global disable_hw_overlays
restore_angle_for_app: settings delete global angle_gl_driver_selection_pkgs && settings delete global angle_gl_driver_selection_values
restore_touch_boost: settings delete system touch.pressure.scale && settings put secure long_press_timeout 400 && settings put secure multi_press_timeout 300
restore_oem_bloat: pm enable com.samsung.android.game.gos 2>/dev/null; pm enable com.xiaomi.joyose 2>/dev/null; pm enable com.huawei.gameassistant 2>/dev/null; pm enable com.vivo.gamecube 2>/dev/null; pm enable com.oplus.space 2>/dev/null; echo 'OEM bloat enabled'
enable_hw_overlays: service call SurfaceFlinger 1008 i32 0 && settings delete global disable_hw_overlays
restore_hwui_overdraw: setprop debug.hwui.overdraw true && setprop debug.hwui.render_dirty_regions true
restore_dalvik: setprop dalvik.vm.execution-mode int:jit && setprop dalvik.vm.dex2oat-filter verify
restore_max_net: settings put global tcp_congestion_control cubic && setprop net.ipv4.tcp_ecn 0 && setprop net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen 0
restore_show_refresh_rate: settings put secure show_refresh_rate 0 && settings put system show_refresh_rate 0 && settings put global show_refresh_rate 0 && settings delete system miui_refresh_rate && service call SurfaceFlinger 1034 i32 0
restore_analytics: settings put global send_action_app_error 1 && settings put secure upload_apk_enable 1
restore_ramdump: setprop persist.sys.ssr.enable_ramdumps 1 && setprop persist.vendor.ssr.enable_ramdumps 1 && setprop persist.sys.crash_rcu 1
restore_bg_dexopt_job: echo 'DexOpt process running in background cannot be aborted abruptly.'
restore_print_service: pm enable com.android.bips 2>/dev/null && pm enable com.android.printspooler 2>/dev/null
